rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Connects to the AntiEntropy Resource Portal knowledge base for nonprofit operations. Provides tools to browse categories, search article content with regex, find articles by title patterns, and read full articles. The portal covers governance, compliance, HR policies, fiscal sponsorship, and operational resources for small nonprofits. Available both as a hosted service on Fly.io and locally via stdio.
